interpretation: The RTX 5090 runtime matches v0.6.7 on every lane gate within run-to-run noise: 130,048-token retrieval exact at 2178.8 tok/s (2,174.5 before), decode 134.8 tok/s wall (134.15), 5.2 GB restore in 3.848/3.647 s (3.89/3.86), fanout medians 1.406/1.821 s (1.40/1.52), tampered restore refused, agent protocol 200/404/404 - and the live-sibling continuation, HTTP 500 on every release since v0.6.2, answers 200.

On the documented route the published image pulled by digest served the same identity the launcher computed, the profile gates re-measured exact through the documented tunnel (2177.7 tok/s, live sibling 200), and the macOS client route passed 10 of 10 including a server restart with the session continued.

The RTX 4090 native lane passed 15 of 15 orchestrated phases on the lane host at 68a0722f and its published component was accepted from public URLs through the documented installer (already_installed, identity match, anonymous 401, completion 200). Its fixed C1 fixture moved to 153.4 tok/s at 87.6% MTP3 acceptance (159.1 at 93.0% before); bisected on the host to the launcher partition, which changes the fp32 summation order of a 2,048-token chunk on 128 SMs - exact within 1.5e-6 relative-L2 on the 4090, byte-identical on five diverse prompts, and the degenerate fixture swings 52-87% with a 1% change in its own length (docs/measurements/2026-09-13-rtx4090-c1-fixture-sensitivity.json).
